items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: I happened to remember, now Sharpe Sister Rosetta sang with a quartet. She had a male quartet with her. I can hear the record now. I remember that.

ctx.x: Yes. (LAUGHTER). That brings something else to mind and that is the whole business, I guess one might almost ask the question now, what is jazz? Because it's going through it seems to me, or has gone through ...........
I happened to remember, now Sharpe Sister Rosetta sang with a quartet. She had a male quartet with her. I can hear the record now. I remember that. Do you remember the 'Golden Gate Quartet'?
Yes, I do, yes I do.
